h: Shabbos Light and the Repair Hidden in Bereishis

p: At the morning meal we say:
We need to understand the expression "yishrei, rest,"
and why it does not say
וְהָעִנְיָן עַל פִּי הַגְּמָרָא (חֲגִיגָה יב, ב)
The matter is based on the Gemara (Chagigah 12b):
But is there darkness before Heaven?
'He knows what is in the darkness,
this refers to the inner chambers,
that refers to the outer chambers."
That is: "and light dwells with Him"
that there is no darkness at all there;
implies that there is no darkness at all there.
And to this the Gemara answers
there is no darkness at all,
is there "He made darkness His concealment."
are what is called "mistarim, hidden places,"
"In hidden places my soul shall weep"
HaKadosh Baruch Hu has a place
and its name is Mistarim, etc.
this refers to the inner chambers, etc.
even though there too there is something
of "the hidden things belong to Hashem,"
for Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who is a chariot for the attribute of Tiferes,
allude to the attributes of Chochmah and Binah,
that belong to Hashem our God" (Devarim 29:28)
there is no grasp of this at all.
which are above the seven attributes,
there is no darkness at all.
for it too is an utterance
"By the word of Hashem the heavens were made"
although "And He said" is not stated there,
"And the earth was chaos and void,
and darkness upon the face of the deep."
there is the spreading-out of thought;
is the very beginning of thought,
and there it was already revealed
before Him, may He be blessed,
as referring to the deeds of the wicked.
which have been arranged and coming
since the six days of Creation, etc."
that is, already at the beginning of thought
and that they would bring out the light
and through this it would become
except that which comes out of darkness
In truth, in the second utterance,
which is among "the hidden things that belong to Hashem our God"
and all the more so in the attribute of Keser Elyon
and there is no darkness at all.
about which it does not say
and it says (Bereishis Rabbah 11:2 and elsewhere):
and the twelve hours of Shabbos."
And in Sefer HaBahir it says
and put it in its place;
there is an illumination from the primordial light.
which is the meal of Atika,
we say, "May His light rest upon it,"
that there be no place at all for darkness.
For at night, at the first meal,
And this is why Rashbi, peace be upon him, composed
seventy facets in the word Bereishis,
"These are the seventy faces of the Torah, etc.,"
and he called them Tikkunei HaZohar.
It is called by the name Zohar
because it is an expression of light;
and "or, light," has the numerical value of "raz, secret,"
and it is the hidden light
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu hid away in the Torah.
and why did he call them Tikkunim, rectifications?
But Rashbi revealed and opened up
the seventy facets in the word Bereishis,
it would be within a person's ability
to rectify everything that has passed over him
and through this he would be shown clearly
which have been arranged and coming
since the six days of Creation,"
and then "they shall become white as snow" (Yeshayahu 1:18).
And David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
שֶׁהֵקִים עוּלָּהּ שֶׁל תְּשׁוּבָה (מוֹעֵד קָטָן טז, ב)
who raised up the yoke of teshuvah (Moed Katan 16b),
"Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow"
that Hashem Yisbarach can make it clear
that he will become even whiter than snow.
it will be made clear through teshuvah:
they shall become white as snow."
and the Ten Days of Teshuvah,
when the second Luchos were given
to Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
together with all the words of Torah,
in order to rectify the great anger.
(as was explained for Rosh Chodesh Elul),
since Shabbos is a time of teshuvah,
"Such is the power of teshuvah, etc.
'A psalm, a song for the Shabbos day'";
and it says in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer:
"'It is good to give thanks (lehodos) to Hashem,'
'And one who confesses and forsakes them shall find mercy.'"
Then the time is more favorable
so that "they shall become white as snow."
